checksum_policy: UW publishes no cryptographic checksums for these archives. The first successful download is hashed with SHA-256 and becomes authoritative for this project; the publisher-reported byte length is checked first.

e0_annual.purpose: 1,000 paired female/male annual life-expectancy trajectories through 2100. Predictive means are shifted to WPP 2024 medium values.

tfr_annual.purpose: 1,000 annual total-fertility trajectories, including uncertainty around annual estimates and projections through 2100. Predictive means are shifted to WPP 2024 medium values.

publisher_note: University of Washington product; not an official UN product
revision_label: UW Bayesian annual trajectories aligned to WPP 2024
